publicationProjection.preservedEvidence: dates, versions, hashes and numeric verification results
publicationProjection.pathPolicy: Repository paths are relative; machine-specific unpublished verification-driver directories use placeholders. Original archived records are unchanged.

adversarial.interpretation: The same adversarial construction is repeated for verification across seeds; these are not independent samples.

limitations: Only generatedAt fields are excluded from E1 content comparisons. All inputs, choices, numerical fields, versions, and source manifest fields remain in the full-report comparison.
No fields are excluded from E2 raw byte or aggregate content comparisons. Aggregate source-manifest or environment differences are reported, not removed to force a match.
Generated candidate utilities and costs are synthetic, not observed model correctness, quality, invoices, or official-price usage costs. No real model was executed in this recheck.
The adversarial construction repeats across three seeds; repetitions do not add independent constructed samples. No runtime speedup follows from expansion counts or disabled timing.

The current source tree is a dirty development checkout. Recorded source byte hashes do not establish a published release, and summary hashes do not retroactively attest to source loaded by earlier runs.
